verdicts.reason: A: the brush-stroke background has shrunk to a thin strip behind the frame, so the top and bottom thirds of the canvas are empty white and the brand texture is mostly gone. The icon and the orange triangle are moved to the left of the text and crowd the headline, but the framed headline stays intact and readable. B: the headline has been pulled out of its frame and sits on plain white, the frame is left as an empty box, and the icon and triangle are stranded in the bottom-left corner. The design no longer holds together, so it is unusable.
